    18	This file composes the two: the translated layer element itself is a member of the public
    19	rank-one locus.  This is the phase-5 endpoint of the recovery route — the translated cover now
    20	lands in the actual public interface rather than stopping at the fieldwise split witness.  No
    21	new witness carrier is introduced; the statement re-exposes the exact translator-degree and
    22	base-subtraction compatibility conjuncts needed by the future covering argument.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    27	
    28	universe u
    29	
    30	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    34	
    35	open AlgebraicJacobian
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    41	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    42	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    43	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	section Membership
    48	
    49	variable [IsSepClosed k]
    50	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    51	
    52	/-- Phase-5 endpoint: over a separably closed base, every degree-zero class over a field
    53	extension acquires, after translation by a base-field class of degree `genus C`, membership in
    54	the public rank-one locus `PicRankOneOpen`.
    55	
    56	The first conclusion is the translator degree; the second re-exposes the finite-support,
    57	residue-degree-one, and base-subtraction compatibility of the exact subtraction divisor; the
    58	last is the new content — the translated layer element belongs to `PicRankOneOpen`, i.e. every
    59	affine pullback of it carries a native rank-one presentation. -/
    60	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslated_mem_picRankOneOpen
    61	    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    62	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    63	    (mu : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K)) :
    64	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
    65	        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
    66	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
    67	        (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu.1)
    68	        (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu.1 d),
    69	      classDeg k (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) = (genus C : Int) ∧
    70	        (Set.Finite (r.S.support : Set {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
    71	            x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) ∧
    72	          (∀ p : {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
    73	              x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left},
    74	            p ∈ r.S.support →
    75	              (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.residueDeg L p.1 = 1) ∧
    76	          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L r.S =
    77	            Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
    78	              ((chartTwistClass C 0 r.Z)⁻¹)) ∧
    79	        r.rankOneLayer mu.1 d ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K)) := by
    80	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r, hdeg, hsupp, hsplit⟩ :=
    81	    exists_sepClosedTranslatedRankOneLayer_pic0 (C := C) mu
    82	  letI := hLfield
    83	  letI := hkL
    84	  letI := hKL
    85	  letI := htow
    86	  letI := hfin
    87	  letI := hsep
    88	  exact ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r, hdeg, hsupp,
    89	    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness pi hpi _ hsplit⟩
    90	
    91	end Membership
    92	
    93	end
    94	
    95	end AlgebraicGeometry

40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    42	
    43	noncomputable section
    44	
    45	section Compatibility
    46	
    47	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    48	  [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
    49	
    50	/-- For a degree-zero input, the base-field class which translates the input into the
    51	rank-one layer has degree `genus C`.
    52	
    53	The proof reads the degree of the exact translated class at the identity field point, then
    54	separates its two factors.  The input contributes zero by `mu.2`, while the base-field factor
    55	contributes its `classDeg` by `degAt_thetaFamily`. -/
    56	theorem SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.translator_classDeg_of_pic0
    57	    (mu : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K))
    58	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu.1)
    59	    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu.1 d) :
    60	    classDeg k (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) = (genus C : Int) := by
    61	  have hdegree :=
    62	    (r.rankOneLayer mu.1 d).2 K (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (overSpec k K))
    63	  rw [SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.rankOneLayer_coe, degAt_mul,
    64	    mu.2 K (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (overSpec k K)),
    65	    degAt_thetaFamily, zero_add] at hdegree
    66	  exact hdegree
    67	
    68	end Compatibility
    69	
    70	section PicZeroProducer
    71	
    72	variable [IsSepClosed k]
    73	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    74	
    75	/-- The general per-field translated rank-one producer in the `Pic^0` indexing required by the
    76	separably closed cover.
    77	
    78	The output is the existing lambda-tied data/result pair.  Its first conclusion says that the
    79	base-field translator has degree `genus C`; its second conclusion makes the precise
    80	finite-support/residue-one/base-subtraction compatibility available; and its last conclusion is
    81	the existing rank-one-layer `IsSplitWitness`.  Thus this is a specialization and immediate
    82	consumer of the general producer, not a fieldwise replacement for `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
    83	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedRankOneLayer_pic0
    84	    (mu : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K)) :
    85	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
    86	        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
    87	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
    88	        (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu.1)
    89	        (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu.1 d),
    90	      classDeg k (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) = (genus C : Int) ∧
    91	        (Set.Finite (r.S.support : Set {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
    92	            x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) ∧
    93	          (∀ p : {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
    94	              x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left},
    95	            p ∈ r.S.support →
    96	              (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.residueDeg L p.1 = 1) ∧
    97	          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L r.S =
    98	            Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
    99	              ((chartTwistClass C 0 r.Z)⁻¹)) ∧
   100	        IsSplitWitness C (r.rankOneLayer mu.1 d).1 := by
   101	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r, hsplit⟩ :=
   102	    exists_sepClosedTranslatedRankOneLayer_general (C := C) mu.1
   103	  letI := hLfield
   104	  letI := hkL
   105	  letI := hKL
   106	  letI := htow
   107	  letI := hfin
   108	  letI := hsep
   109	  exact ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r,
   110	    r.translator_classDeg_of_pic0 mu d,
   111	    r.baseSubtraction_compatibility mu.1 d,
   112	    hsplit⟩
   113	
   114	end PicZeroProducer
   115	
   116	end
   117	
   118	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentation
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The rank-one evaluation zero-locus comparison
    10	
    11	The canonical inverse is cut out by the evaluation counit, while the existing divisor engine
    12	consumes the tied cocycle datum's local equations.  This file proves the section-level comparison
    13	between those two descriptions before any Noetherian or regularity hypothesis is introduced.
    14	
    15	For a tied local presentation, transporting a datum section through `module_iso.inv` commutes
    16	with restriction to every open.  Since every component of the sheaf isomorphism is injective,
    17	restriction vanishes on the module side exactly when it vanishes on the datum side.  Applying
    18	this to the canonical unit-lift through the evaluation counit identifies its restriction-
    19	vanishing predicate with that of `datumSection`.  The final theorem specializes the comparison
    20	to `PicRankOneNativePresentation`, whose converted module is definitionally the native module.
    21	
    22	The second half passes to the canonical `O_X`-linear piece trivializations of the native module.
    23	It proves that the evaluated section has coordinate `datum.component` on every cocycle piece, and
    24	hence that the two principal local ideals agree.  This closes the local equation comparison, but
    25	does not yet glue those ideals into a base-change-compatible family-level evaluation divisor.  The
    26	file also does not assert regularity or manufacture the still-missing arbitrary-affine presentation
    27	producer.
    28	-/
    29	
    30	set_option autoImplicit false
    31	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    32	
    33	universe u
    34	
    35	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    36	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    37	
    38	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    39	
    40	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    41	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    42	
    43	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    44	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    45	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    46	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    47	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    48	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    49	
    50	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    51	
    52	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    53	
    54	/-- The coordinate of a native global section on one cocycle piece.
    55	
    56	This is obtained by restricting the section to `D.pieces j` and applying the canonical
    57	`O_X`-linear trivialization of the native module there. -/
    58	noncomputable def nativePieceCoordinate
    59	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    60	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)))
    61	    (j : D.index) : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
    62	  gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j le_rfl
    63	    (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit
    64	      (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)) s)
    65	
    66	/-- The native coordinate is the datum component of the same global section. -/
    67	theorem nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component
    68	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    69	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)))
    70	    (j : D.index) :
    71	    D.nativePieceCoordinate s j = D.component s j := by
    72	  rw [nativePieceCoordinate, gluedTriv_apply, gluedRes_coe]
    73	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom, component]
    74	
    75	/-- Native piece coordinates commute with arbitrary affine coefficient extension. -/
    76	theorem nativePieceCoordinate_sectionsMapTop
    77	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    78	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
    79	    [IsScalarTower k B B']
    80	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)))
    81	    (j : D.index) :
    82	    (D.baseChange B').nativePieceCoordinate (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) j =
    83	      D.toBasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap B' j (D.nativePieceCoordinate s j) := by
    84	  rw [(D.baseChange B').nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component,
    85	    D.component_sectionsMapTop B' s, D.nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component]
    86	
    87	/-- The principal native-coordinate ideal is preserved by arbitrary affine coefficient
    88	extension. This is the ideal-level consumer of `nativePieceCoordinate_sectionsMapTop`. -/
    89	theorem nativePieceIdeal_sectionsMapTop
    90	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    91	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
    92	    [IsScalarTower k B B']
    93	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)))
    94	    (j : D.index) :
    95	    Ideal.map (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap B' j)
    96	        (Ideal.span {D.nativePieceCoordinate s j}) =
    97	      Ideal.span {
    98	        (D.baseChange B').nativePieceCoordinate (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) j} := by
    99	  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, D.nativePieceCoordinate_sectionsMapTop]
   100	  rfl
   101	
   102	/-- The inverse of the native base-ring section equivalence is the identity on underlying
   103	sections. -/
   104	@[simp]
   105	theorem nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv_symm_apply
   106	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   107	    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) (s : D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
   108	    (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv U).symm s = s := by
   109	  apply (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv U).injective
   110	  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
   111	  rfl
   112	
   113	/-- The inverse component of the native base-ring sheaf isomorphism is the identity on
   114	underlying sections. -/
   115	@[simp]
   116	theorem nativeModuleKSheafIso_inv_app
   117	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   118	    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) (s : D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
   119	    (D.nativeModuleKSheafIso.inv.hom.app (op U)).hom s = s := by
   120	  change (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv U).symm s = s
   121	  exact D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv_symm_apply U s
   122	
   123	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   124	
   125	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
   126	
   127	/-- Transport through the tied sheaf isomorphism commutes with restriction on sections. -/
   128	theorem module_iso_inv_restrict
   129	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   130	    {U V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
   131	    (s : P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
   132	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   133	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
   134	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   135	      ((P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op U)).hom s)) =
   136	      (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op V)).hom
   137	        ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom s) := by
   138	  exact congrArg (fun z => z.hom s)
   139	    (P.module_iso.inv.hom.naturality (homOfLE h).op).symm
   140	
   141	/-- Restriction vanishes after transport to the base-ring module exactly when the datum restriction
   142	vanishes.  This is a pointwise section comparison supplied by `module_iso`; it is not a statement
   143	about the native `O_X`-module ideal and needs no Noetherian hypothesis. -/
   144	theorem module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff
   145	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   146	    {U V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
   147	    (s : P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
   148	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   149	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
   150	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   151	      ((P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op U)).hom s) = 0) ↔
   152	      ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom s = 0) := by
   153	  rw [P.module_iso_inv_restrict h s]
   154	  exact map_eq_zero_iff _
   155	    (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
   156	      (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op V))).1
   157	
   158	/-- The evaluation counit sends the canonical H⁰ unit-lift to the module section obtained
   159	from the tied datum class. -/
   160	theorem evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv
   161	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   162	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   163	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   164	      ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   165	        (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   166	      (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := by
   167	  calc
   168	    _ = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y
   169	    _ = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := rfl
   170	
   171	/-- The canonical evaluation section and the tied datum section have the same restriction-
   172	vanishing predicate on every open of the relative curve.
   173	
   174	This is the immediate consumer of `module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff`: the evaluated section
   175	is first identified with `moduleSectionsEquiv y`, then with the inverse image of
   176	`datumSection y` under the presentation's sheaf isomorphism. -/
   177	theorem evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff
   178	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   179	    {V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ ⊤)
   180	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   181	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   182	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
   183	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   184	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   185	        ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   186	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   187	        (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) = 0) ↔
   188	      ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   189	        (P.datumSection y) = 0) := by
   190	  rw [P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv y]
   191	  rw [← P.module_iso_inv_datumSection y]
   192	  exact P.module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff h (P.datumSection y)
   193	
   194	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation
   195	
   196	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
   197	
   198	/-- Native specialization of the evaluation/datum zero-locus comparison.
   199	
   200	`toLocalPresentation.module` is definitionally `P.datum.nativeModule`, so this theorem is the
   201	consumer-facing native base-ring section comparison rather than a second choice of line bundle.
   202	The native `O_X`-linear ideal comparison remains a separate producer obligation. -/
   203	theorem evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff
   204	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
   205	    {V : (relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ ⊤)
   206	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0) :
   207	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   208	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier ↘
   209	        Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)))
   210	        P.toLocalPresentation.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   211	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation
   212	        ((relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier ↘
   213	          Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   214	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   215	        (P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) = 0) ↔
   216	      ((P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   217	        (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) = 0) := by
   218	  exact P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff h y
   219	
   220	/-- Under the native trivialization, the section attached to a datum `H⁰` class has the datum's
   221	component as its coordinate on every cocycle piece. -/
   222	theorem moduleSectionsEquiv_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component
   223	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
   224	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0)
   225	    (j : P.datum.index) :
   226	    P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate (P.toLocalPresentation.moduleSectionsEquiv y) j =
   227	      P.datum.component (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) j := by
   228	  rw [← P.toLocalPresentation.module_iso_inv_datumSection y]
   229	  change P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate
   230	      ((P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso.inv.hom.app
   231	        (op (⊤ : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens))).hom
   232	          (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y)) j = _
   233	  rw [P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso_inv_app]
   234	  exact P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component _ j
   235	
   236	/-- The canonical evaluation counit section has `datum.component` as its coordinate under the
   237	native `O_X`-linear trivialization on every cocycle piece. -/
   238	theorem evaluationLift_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component
   239	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
   240	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0)
   241	    (j : P.datum.index) :
   242	    P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate
   243	        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation
   244	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   245	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   246	          (P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) j =
   247	      P.datum.component (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) j := by
   248	  -- `erw` bridges the defeq `P.cover` vs `P.toLocalPresentation.cover` projection gap
   249	  erw [P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv y]
   250	  exact P.moduleSectionsEquiv_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component y j
   251	
   252	/-- The principal ideal cut out by the native evaluation section on a cocycle piece is exactly
   253	the principal ideal generated by the datum component consumed by the divisor engine. -/
   254	theorem evaluationLift_nativePieceIdeal_eq_componentIdeal
   255	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
   256	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0)
   257	    (j : P.datum.index) :
   258	    Ideal.span {P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate
   259	        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation
   260	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   261	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   262	          (P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) j} =
   263	      Ideal.span {P.datum.component (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) j} := by
   264	  rw [P.evaluationLift_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component y j]
   265	
   266	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   267	
   268	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-
     2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocalDivisor
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Affine evaluation-divisor coherence for the FibrePresented producer
    10	
    11	The arbitrary-scheme `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` producer needs a divisor cut by the
    12	canonical evaluation section which is stable under restriction of affine test schemes.  This
    13	file records two construction-level inputs for that gluing step:
    14	
    15	* `datumSectionBaseChange_tower` proves that the tied datum section itself is coherent along
    16	  every affine coefficient tower;
    17	* `baseOpenRankOneDivisor_mul_eq` proves independence of the chosen rank-one generator after
    18	  passing to a pairwise product open.
    19	
    20	The remaining gluing edge is deliberately explicit: one must identify `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` of
    21	the local divisor with the divisor cut by the tower-transported section.  No
    22	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` or pullback-square hypothesis is introduced here.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
    32	open scoped TensorProduct
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    37	
    38	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    39	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    40	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    41	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    42	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    43	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    44	
    45	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    46	
    47	/-- The actual section attached to a tied presentation is transitive under arbitrary affine
    48	coefficient extension.  The cast is along the canonical equality between iterated and direct
    49	base change of the same cocycle datum. -/
    50	theorem datumSectionBaseChange_tower
    51	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    52	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    53	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
    54	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B']
    55	    [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
    56	    [IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier B B']
    57	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
    58	    let hD : (P.datum.baseChange B).baseChange B' = P.datum.baseChange B' :=
    59	      P.datum.baseChange_baseChange C P.cover.Carrier B B'
    60	    cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B' pi =>
    61	      ↑(gluedSubmodule B' E.pieces E.unit ⊤)) hD)
    62	        ((P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop B'
    63	          (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y)) =
    64	      P.datumSectionBaseChange B' y := by
    65	  rw [P.datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul B y,
    66	    P.datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul B' y]
    67	  exact P.datum.sectionsMapTop_tower
    68	    C P.cover.Carrier B B' (P.datumSection y)
    69	
    70	/-- A generator which is fibrewise nonzero on `D(f)` remains so on `D(f * g)`. -/
    71	theorem generator_nonzero_on_mul_left
    72	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    73	    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
    74	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    75	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
    76	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    77	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    78	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    79	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f * g ∉ p.asIdeal →
    80	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    81	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    82	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
    83	  intro p hfg
    84	  exact hy p fun hf => hfg (p.asIdeal.mul_mem_right g hf)
    85	
    86	/-- A generator which is fibrewise nonzero on `D(g)` remains so on `D(f * g)`. -/
    87	theorem generator_nonzero_on_mul_right
    88	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    89	    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
    90	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    91	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, g ∉ p.asIdeal →
    92	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    93	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    94	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    95	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f * g ∉ p.asIdeal →
    96	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    97	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    98	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
    99	  intro p hfg
   100	  exact hy p fun hg => hfg (p.asIdeal.mul_mem_left f hg)
   101	
   102	/-- Local evaluation divisors cut by two rank-one generators agree on the direct pairwise
   103	product open.  This is the generator-independence half of the compatibility premise required
   104	by `divFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_basic_compat`. -/
   105	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_mul_eq
   106	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   107	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   108	    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
   109	    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   110	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   111	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   112	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   113	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   114	    (hy' : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, g ∉ p.asIdeal →
   115	      (y' ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   116	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   117	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   118	    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f * g) y
   119	        (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_left f g y hy) =
   120	      P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f * g) y'
   121	        (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_right f g y' hy') :=
   122	  P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_eq (f * g) y y'
   123	    (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_left f g y hy)
   124	    (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_right f g y' hy')
   125	
   126	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation
   127	
   128	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-
     2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	-/
     5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRankOneOpen
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentation
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Assembly from a rank-one divisor-fibre pullback
    10	
    11	This file isolates the last presheaf step in the arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre construction.
    12	Its input ties an open `W` to the displayed family, supplies native presentations on every
    13	affine pullback, and supplies the canonical evaluation-divisor classifier.  The geometric input
    14	to the assembly theorem is the genuine pullback square of that evaluation divisor along Abel.
    15	The universal property of this stronger square produces, rather than assumes, the factorisation
    16	field of `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
    17	
    18	The global construction of the canonical classifier and its represented pullbacks remains an
    19	upstream obligation.  The endpoint here keeps that obligation in its geometric `IsPullback`
    20	form and feeds the resulting arbitrary-scheme fibres immediately to
    21	`picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented`.
    22	
    23	Thus this module is a conditional assembly interface, not the missing global producer: no
    24	declaration below constructs the evaluator, the open family, or its pullback theorem.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    33	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    41	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    42	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    43	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	abbrev rankOneAmbient : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    48	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    49	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))
    50	
    51	abbrev rankOneLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    52	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
    53	
    54	/-- The divisor families whose Abel class has a rank-one presentation, extended to the big site. -/
    55	abbrev rankOneDivisorLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    56	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor
    58	
    59	/-- The restricted represented Abel map on the big site. -/
    60	def rankOneAbelSigma :
    61	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
    62	      rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
    63	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (rankOneAbelRepresented pi)
    64	
    65	/-- The ambient class of a divisor already known to lie in the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    66	def rankOneDivisorToAmbient :
    67	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C) :=
    68	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi
    69	
    70	/-! ## The explicit geometric input -/
    71	
    72	/-- The single canonical evaluation-divisor classifier used by every represented fibre.
    73	
    74	Keeping this datum outside `PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput` prevents the classifier from
    75	varying with the test scheme or displayed family. -/
    76	structure PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData where
    77	  divisor : rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
    78	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)
    79	  divisor_abel : divisor ≫ rankOneAbelSigma pi = 𝟙 _
    80	
    81	namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
    82	
    83	/-- Applying restricted Abel to the canonical evaluation divisor recovers its rank-one class. -/
    84	lemma divisor_abel_app (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
    85	    (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) :
    86	    (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) = v := by
    87	  exact congrArg (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_abel
    88	
    89	/-- The canonical divisor has the original ambient Picard class. -/
    90	lemma divisor_toAmbient (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
    91	    E.divisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi = picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi := by
    92	  rw [rankOneDivisorToAmbient, ← Category.assoc, E.divisor_abel, Category.id_comp]
    93	
    94	/-- The separate uniqueness obligation saying every divisor in the rank-one presentation
    95	preimage is the canonical evaluation divisor of its Abel class. -/
    96	def AbelInverse (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) : Prop :=
    97	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ E.divisor = 𝟙 _
    98	
    99	/-- Once divisor uniqueness is proved, restricted Abel and canonical evaluation form the
   100	rank-one family isomorphism. -/
   101	def evaluationIso (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) (h : E.AbelInverse) :
   102	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ≅ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) where
   103	  hom := rankOneAbelSigma pi
   104	  inv := E.divisor
   105	  hom_inv_id := h
   106	  inv_hom_id := E.divisor_abel
   107	
   108	end PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
   109	
   110	/--
   111	The explicit data needed to assemble one arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre.
   112	
   113	`restrictedValue` is the restriction of the displayed ambient family to `W`, and
   114	`nativePresentation` quantifies over every affine pullback of that value.  The parameter `E` is
   115	the common evaluation-divisor classifier on the rank-one locus, with its Abel compatibility
   116	kept explicit.  Divisor representability is deliberately not a field of this structure: it is
   117	supplied separately as a pullback square to the assembly theorem.
   118	
   119	In particular, no field-fibre dimension witness, unrelated line bundle, or pre-existing
   120	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` is accepted by this contract.  Conversely, this structure is not
   121	itself a producer: an inhabitant must still supply the arbitrary-affine native presentations.
   122	-/
   123	structure PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   124	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
   125	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   126	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)) where
   127	  W : X.Opens
   128	  restrictedValue : rankOneAmbient (C := C).obj (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   129	  restrictedValue_eq :
   130	    restrictedValue =
   131	      (yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (W : Scheme.{u}))
   132	  /-- The tied native presentation on every affine pullback of the restricted family value. -/
   133	  nativePresentation :
   134	    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   135	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ Over.mk restrictedValue.1),
   136	      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   137	        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op restrictedValue.2))
   138	
   139	namespace PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   140	
   141	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   142	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)}
   143	variable {E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi}
   144	
   145	/-- The public-locus element carried by the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   146	noncomputable def locusValue (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   147	    (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) :=
   148	  ⟨F.restrictedValue.1, ⟨F.restrictedValue.2,
   149	    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
   150	      (fun A _ _ t => F.nativePresentation A t)⟩⟩
   151	
   152	/-- The map into the public locus is obtained from its universal element by Yoneda. -/
   153	noncomputable def fst (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   154	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   155	  yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue
   156	
   157	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor of the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   158	noncomputable def evaluationDivisor
   159	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   160	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   161	  F.fst ≫ E.divisor
   162	
   163	/-- The factorisation clause required by `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, exposed as the target
   164	of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/
   165	def FibreFactorizationClause
   166	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   167	  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
   168	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =
   169	      g.app (op S) w →
   170	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
   171	      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w
   172	
   173	lemma fst_comp_incl (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   174	    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   175	  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
   176	  rw [yonedaEquiv_comp, fst, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, yonedaEquiv_apply,
   177	    ← F.restrictedValue_eq]
   178	  dsimp [locusValue, picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   179	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]
   180	  rfl
   181	
   182	/-- The family evaluation divisor has the displayed family as its Abel class. -/
   183	lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
   184	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   185	    F.evaluationDivisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi =
   186	      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   187	  rw [evaluationDivisor, Category.assoc, E.divisor_toAmbient]
   188	  exact F.fst_comp_incl
   189	
   190	/-! ## The represented rank-one-divisor fibre square -/
   191	
   192	/-- The open `W` represents the pullback of the restricted divisor-class map along the displayed
   193	family, with its top map fixed by the canonical evaluation divisor.  This is stronger than the
   194	factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a categorical pullback against the
   195	entire restricted rank-one divisor presheaf. -/
   196	def EvaluationDivisorPullback
   197	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   198	  IsPullback
   199	    F.evaluationDivisor
   200	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
   201	    (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi)
   202	    g
   203	
   204	/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
   205	test scheme. -/
   206	lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   207	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   208	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   209	    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
   210	  intro S v w hvw
   211	  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)
   212	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hS
   213	  have hcompat :
   214	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   215	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   216	        g.app (op S) w := by
   217	    have h := congrArg
   218	      (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_toAmbient
   219	    change
   220	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   221	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   222	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v at h
   223	    rw [h]
   224	    exact hvw
   225	  obtain ⟨u, huDivisor, huW⟩ :=
   226	    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat
   227	  change E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
   228	    E.divisor.app (op S) v at huDivisor
   229	  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
   230	  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
   231	  calc
   232	    F.fst.app (op S) u =
   233	        (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S)
   234	          (E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u)) :=
   235	      (E.divisor_abel_app pi S (F.fst.app (op S) u)).symm
   236	    _ = (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) :=
   237	      congrArg _ huDivisor
   238	    _ = v := E.divisor_abel_app pi S v
   239	
   240	/-! ## Assembly of the stronger fibre datum -/
   241	
   242	/-- Assemble the public fibre presentation from the represented canonical evaluation-divisor
   243	square.  Its `exists_factor` field is derived from the pullback universal property. -/
   244	noncomputable def toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   245	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   246	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   247	    PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g where
   248	  W := F.W
   249	  fst := F.fst
   250	  sq := F.fst_comp_incl
   251	  exists_factor := by
   252	    simpa only [FibreFactorizationClause] using
   253	      F.fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb
   254	
   255	@[simp]
   256	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_W
   257	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   258	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   259	    (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).W = F.W :=
   260	  rfl
   261	
   262	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_isPullback
   263	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   264	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   265	    IsPullback F.fst (yoneda.map F.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g :=
   266	  (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).isPullback
   267	
   268	/-! ## Immediate openness consumer -/
   269	
   270	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies
   271	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
   272	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   273	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   274	      PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   275	    (hpb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   276	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   277	      (D X g).EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   278	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   279	  apply picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented pi
   280	  intro X g
   281	  exact (D X g).toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi (hpb X g)
   282	
   283	end PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   284	
   285	end
   286	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRep
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Category-correct ambient contract for the rank-one Picard route
    11	
    12	The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
    13	ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:
    14	
    15	* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
    16	* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
    17	* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.

    19	The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
    20	`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
    21	`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
    22	`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
    23	inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.

    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u

    31	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

    37	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

    43	def abelDivAffTrans : divFunctorAff C n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
    44	  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDivAff' C n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDivAff' s t⟩

    53	    ((abelDivAffTrans C n).app T s).1 = abelDivAff' C n T.unop s :=
    54	  rfl
    55

    57	/-- Extend a represented widened Abel map from the slice over `Spec k` to the big site. -/
    58	def abelDivAffSigma {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    59	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) :
    60	    yoneda.obj D.left ⟶
    61	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ)) :=
    62	  rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (abelDivAffTrans C n)
    63	
    64	@[simp]
    65	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_fst {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    66	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    67	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    68	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).1 = x ≫ D.hom :=
    69	  rfl
    70	
    71	@[simp]
    72	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_coe {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    73	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    74	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    75	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).2.1 =
    76	      abelDivAff' C n (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom)) (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)) :=
    77	  rfl

    81

    83	be an open immersion. -/
    84	def abelDivAffGenusSigma :

    86	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
    87	  abelDivAffSigma C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C)

     9	/-!
    10	# The universal divisor rank-one open contract
    11	
    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
    16	representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.
    17	
    18	This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.

    39	/-- The universal genus-divisor predicate whose Abel class lies in `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
    40	def divRankOneUniversalPredicate :
    41	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    42	  divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi

    44	/-- Evaluation of the represented genus Abel map on a slice point, with the base morphism
    45	transported from the point in the divisor representer to its source. -/
    46	theorem abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne
    47	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    48	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    49	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.left) q.left =
    50	      (⟨T.hom,
    51	        (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    52	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩ :
    53	        (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    54	          (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) := by
    55	  change (⟨q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom, _⟩ :
    56	      (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	        (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) =
    58	    ⟨T.hom,
    59	      (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    60	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩
    61	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext
    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) q.w ?_
    63	  let e : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶ T :=
    64	    Over.mkCongr q.w
    65	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶
    66	      divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
    67	    Over.homMk q.left rfl
    68	  have hq : e ≫ q = q' := by
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact Category.id_comp _
    71	  change (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map e.op
    72	      ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    73	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)) =
    74	    (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app
    75	      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)))
    76	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q')
    77	  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    78	    ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).naturality e.op)
    79	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)
    80	  have hhom :
    81	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    82	        (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    83	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) := by
    84	    calc
    85	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    86	          (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (e ≫ q) := by
    87	            rw [hq]
    88	      _ = (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    89	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) :=
    90	        (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp e q
    91	  rw [hhom]
    92	  simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hnat.symm

    94	/-- A represented genus divisor lies in the universal predicate exactly when its Abel image
    95	lifts through the single public rank-one Picard locus. -/
    96	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma
    97	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    98	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    99	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   100	      ∃ v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   101	          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (op T.unop.left),
   102	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left) v =
   103	          (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left := by
   104	  simp only [divRankOneUniversalPredicate,
   105	    divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter,
   106	    Subfunctor.preimage_obj, Set.mem_preimage]
   107	  let p := (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   108	    ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv x)
   109	  change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔ _
   110	  have hleft :
   111	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left =
   112	        (⟨T.unop.hom, p⟩ :
   113	          (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   114	            (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj
   115	              (op T.unop.left)) :=
   116	    abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne x
   117	  constructor
   118	  · intro hp
   119	    refine ⟨⟨T.unop.hom, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   120	    rw [hleft]
   121	    rfl
   122	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   123	    rw [hleft] at hv
   124	    dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   125	      CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at hv
   126	    rcases v with ⟨a, y⟩
   127	    dsimp at hv
   128	    have hfirst : a = T.unop.hom :=
   129	      congrArg (fun z => z.1) hv
   130	    cases hfirst
   131	    have hinj := Sigma.mk.inj hv
   132	    have heq :
   133	        ConcreteCategory.hom
   134	            ((PicRankOneOpen pi).ι.app
   135	              (op (Over.mk T.unop.hom))) y = p :=
   136	      eq_of_heq hinj.2
   137	    change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T
   138	    rw [← heq]
   139	    exact y.property

   141	/-- The Yoneda map induced by the inclusion of an open of an object in the slice.  Naming this
   142	map is useful to consumers which need the actual factorisation through the open, rather than only
   143	the proposition that a point lies in its range. -/
   144	def openSubfunctorMap (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   145	    yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) ⟶ yoneda.obj D :=
   146	  yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) U.ι)
   147	
   148	/-- The subfunctor represented by an open `U` of an object `D` in the slice over `Spec k`.
   149	
   150	Its values are precisely morphisms which factor through the open immersion `U.ι`; using the
   151	Yoneda range keeps this definition independent of any chosen affine presentation of `U`. -/
   152	def openSubfunctor (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   153	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj D) :=
   154	  Subfunctor.range (openSubfunctorMap D U)
   155	
   156	/-- Unpack range membership into the actual source point and its equality in the ambient Yoneda
   157	functor.  This is the pointwise factorisation API used by inverse constructions. -/
   158	theorem openSubfunctor_mem_iff
   159	    (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens)
   160	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   161	    (x : (yoneda.obj D).obj T) :
   162	    x ∈ (openSubfunctor D U).obj T ↔
   163	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom))).obj T,
   164	        (openSubfunctorMap D U).app T y = x := by
   165	  rfl

   167	/-- An explicit geometric certificate for the universal rank-one predicate.
   168	
   169	The equality is the missing family-level producer/gluing statement: it identifies the logical
   170	preimage with an actual open of the canonical genus representer.  No default or top-open witness
   171	is manufactured here. -/
   172	structure DivRankOneOpenData (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] where
   173	  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens
   174	  carrier_eq :
   175	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) carrier =
   176	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi
   177	
   178	/-- Genuine relative openness of the public Picard rank-one locus produces the universal
   179	divisor rank-one open.  The carrier is the open image of the represented pullback of the Abel
   180	map, and the proof below identifies its Yoneda range with the defining predicate. -/
   181	theorem divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen
   182	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) :
   183	    Nonempty (DivRankOneOpenData pi) := by
   184	  obtain ⟨X, snd, fst, hpb⟩ := h.rep (abelDivAffGenusSigma C)
   185	  letI : IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   186	    h.property (abelDivAffGenusSigma C) fst snd hpb
   187	  let U := snd.opensRange
   188	  refine ⟨⟨U, ?_⟩⟩
   189	  ext T x
   190	  rw [openSubfunctor_mem_iff]
   191	  rw [divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma]
   192	  have hpbT := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op T.unop.left)
   193	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbT
   194	  constructor
   195	  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
   196	    have hxy : x.left = y.left ≫ U.ι := by
   197	      have hleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hy
   198	      exact hleft.symm
   199	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range snd.base := by
   200	      rw [← Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange snd]
   201	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   202	      rw [hxy, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
   203	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ snd.opensRange
   204	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ U
   205	      exact (y.left.base t).property
   206	    let u : T.unop.left ⟶ X :=
   207	      IsOpenImmersion.lift snd x.left hrange
   208	    have hu : u ≫ snd = x.left :=
   209	      IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   210	    refine ⟨fst.app (op T.unop.left) u, ?_⟩
   211	    have hcomm := congrArg
   212	      (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) u) hpbT.1
   213	    change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left)
   214	        (fst.app (op T.unop.left) u) =
   215	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) (u ≫ snd) at hcomm
   216	    simpa only [hu] using hcomm
   217	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   218	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := hpbT.2.2 v x.left hv
   219	    change u ≫ snd = x.left at hu₂
   220	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range U.ι.base := by
   221	      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
   222	      change Set.range x.left.base ⊆ snd.opensRange
   223	      rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange]
   224	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   225	      refine ⟨u.base t, ?_⟩
   226	      have happ := congrArg (fun f => f.base t) hu₂
   227	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using happ
   228	    let V : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   229	      Over.mk (U.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   230	    let j : V ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   231	      Over.homMk (U := V) U.ι
   232	    let e : U.toScheme = V.left := rfl
   233	    let l : T.unop.left ⟶ U.toScheme :=
   234	      IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι x.left hrange
   235	    let l' : T.unop.left ⟶ V.left := l ≫ eqToHom e
   236	    have he : eqToHom e ≫ j.left = U.ι := by
   237	      subst e
   238	      rfl
   239	    have hl : l' ≫ j.left = x.left := by
   240	      dsimp only [l']
   241	      rw [Category.assoc, he]
   242	      dsimp only [l]
   243	      exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   244	    have hlw : l' ≫ V.hom = T.unop.hom := by
   245	      rw [← j.w, ← Category.assoc, hl]
   246	      exact x.w
   247	    let y : (yoneda.obj V).obj T := Over.homMk l' hlw
   248	    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
   249	    change y ≫ j = x
   250	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
   251	    exact hl

   253	/-- A named carrier choice for consumers which already possess the Picard openness theorem. -/
   254	def divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen
   255	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : DivRankOneOpenData pi :=
   256	  Classical.choice (divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen pi h)
   257	
   258	/-- The open subscheme supplied by a `DivRankOneOpenData` witness. -/
   259	def DivRankOneOpen (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) : Scheme :=
   260	  h.carrier.toScheme
   261	
   262	/-- The canonical open immersion into the genus divisor representer. -/
   263	def divRankOneOpenMap (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   264	    DivRankOneOpen pi h ⟶ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left :=
   265	  h.carrier.ι
   266	
   267	theorem divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion
   268	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   269	    IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenMap pi h) := by
   270	  change IsOpenImmersion h.carrier.ι
   271	  infer_instance
   272	
   273	/- The scheme-level certificate also has the presheaf form consumed by relative-open inverse
   274	   constructions.  This is conditional only on the explicit carrier witness above. -/
   275	theorem divRankOneOpenMap_presheaf_isOpenImmersion
   276	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   277	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenMap pi h)) := by
   278	  exact MorphismProperty.relative_map (divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion pi h)
   279	
   280	/-- The open represented object, retained in the slice over `Spec k` for consumers of the affine
   281	divisor functor. -/
   282	def divRankOneOpenOver (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   283	    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   284	  Over.mk (divRankOneOpenMap pi h ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   285	
   286	/-- The inclusion of the certified open, as a morphism in the slice over `Spec k`.
   287	
   288	This is the map whose Yoneda action is consumed by the canonical rank-one Abel inverse.  Naming
   289	it separately keeps consumers independent of the implementation spelling of `divRankOneOpenOver`.
   290	-/
   291	def divRankOneOpenOverMap (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   292	    divRankOneOpenOver pi h ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   293	  Over.homMk (divRankOneOpenMap pi h)
   294	
   295	/-- Pull back the certified rank-one open along an arbitrary slice morphism. -/
   296	def divRankOneOpenPullback
   297	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   298	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) : T.left.Opens :=
   299	  q.left ⁻¹ᵁ h.carrier
   300	
   301	theorem divRankOneOpenPullback_isOpenImmersion
   302	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   303	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
   304	    IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q).ι := by
   305	  infer_instance
   306	
   307	/-- The arbitrary slice pullback remains an open immersion after passing to Yoneda. -/
   308	theorem divRankOneOpenPullbackMap_presheaf_isOpenImmersion
   309	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   310	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
   311	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf
   312	      (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q).ι) := by
   313	  exact MorphismProperty.relative_map (divRankOneOpenPullback_isOpenImmersion pi h q)
   314	
   315	/-- Pointwise form of arbitrary base-change compatibility for the certified open. -/
   316	theorem mem_divRankOneOpenPullback_iff
   317	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   318	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C)
   319	    (x : T.left) :
   320	    x ∈ divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q ↔ q.left.base x ∈ h.carrier := by
   321	  rfl
   322	
   323	/-- The universal predicate is exactly the represented preimage used by the Abel restriction. -/
   324	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_eq_preimage :
   325	    divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi = divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi :=
   326	  rfl
   327	
   328	/-- The certified open carrier has the universal rank-one predicate as its Yoneda range. -/
   329	theorem divRankOneOpen_carrier_eq
   330	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   331	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier =
   332	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi :=
   333	  h.carrier_eq
   334	
   335	/-- Pointwise form of the witness equality, exposing the exact contract consumed by an inverse.
   336	
   337	The right-hand side is the range of the open immersion, so a consumer can use this theorem to
   338	replace a rank-one predicate proof by a factorisation through `DivRankOneOpen pi h`. -/
   339	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff
   340	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   341	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   342	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   343	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   344	      x ∈ (openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).obj T := by
   345	  rw [h.carrier_eq]
   346	
   347	/-- A point of the universal rank-one predicate factors through the certified open immersion.
   348	
   349	Unlike a bare range-membership proof, the conclusion exposes the source point and the equality
   350	of its image with the given divisor point, which is the exact data needed by a canonical inverse. -/
   351	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization
   352	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   353	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   354	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   355	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   356	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk
   357	          (h.carrier.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom))).obj T,
   358	        (openSubfunctorMap (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).app T y = x := by
   359	  rw [divRankOneOpen_mem_iff pi h x, openSubfunctor_mem_iff]

    51	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    52	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    53	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    54	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    55	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    56	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    57	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
    58	
    59	/-- The FLV class theorem in the spelling used by the translated-cover lane.
    60	
    61	The class `l` is the presenting class of the input fibre, while `theta` is the positive
    62	base-field twist.  Keeping this as a named wrapper makes the positive-twist step visible at the
    63	call site; it does not manufacture a presentation or hide the input class in an unrelated
    64	existential. -/
    65	theorem exists_positive_twist_vanishing
    66	    (π : Y ⟶ P1 K) [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
    67	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap K = Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    68	    (l θ : Y.CechPic) (hθ : 1 ≤ classDeg K θ) :
    69	    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n₀, ∀ W : Y.CurveDivisor,
    70	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K W = l * θ ^ n →
    71	        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1) := by
    72	  exact exists_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_one_le_classDeg_of_isFinite_toP1
    73	    π hπ l θ hθ
    74	
    75	end PositiveTwist

    77	/-! ## The lambda-tied drop package -/
    78	
    79	section DropPackage
    80	
    81	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    82	  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
    83	  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    84	
    85	/-- Data for the positive twist and the subsequent point subtraction.
    86	
    87	`hM₀` ties the splitting field presentation to the particular input `mu`; `hW₀` says that the
    88	divisor being reduced is in the positive twist class (the chart index is zero at this stage).
    89	`baseSubtraction` is intentionally an explicit class-level bridge: it says that the divisor
    90	returned by the greedy reduction is represented by a base-field divisor.  The current tree has
    91	the graph-class version of this bridge but no divisor pullback operation, so this hypothesis is
    92	kept visible rather than replaced by a fieldwise existential. -/
    93	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropData (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) where
    94	  m : ℕ
    95	  M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic
    96	  hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
    97	    PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀)
    98	  W₀ : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
    99	  hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   100	    M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   101	      (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor))
   102	  genusValue : ℕ
   103	  excess : ℕ
   104	  hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genusValue : ℤ)
   105	  hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genusValue : ℤ) + excess
   106	  h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   107	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)
   108	  P : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   109	  hdense : ∀ U : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).Opens,
   110	    (U : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)).Nonempty → (P ∩ U).Nonempty
   111	  hPcl : ∀ x ∈ P, x ≠ genericPoint ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   112	  hPdeg : ∀ x ∈ P, ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L x = 1
   113	  baseSubtraction : ∀ (S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
   114	    0 ≤ S → Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (excess : ℤ) →
   115	      (∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   116	        coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ P) →
   117	      ∃ Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor,
   118	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   119	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   120	            ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   121	
   122	/-- The output of the positive-twist/drop construction, tied to both the input class and the
   123	base-field translating divisor.
   124	
   125	The final field is the existing fibre consumer.  In particular, `S` is not merely a divisor
   126	with the right cohomology: `baseClass` identifies its class with the base change of `Z`, and
   127	`translated` is about `mu` translated by the resulting base-field class
   128	`chartTwistClass C d.m Z`. -/
   129	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   130	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) where
   131	  S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
   132	  Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor
   133	  nonnegative : 0 ≤ S
   134	  degree : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (d.excess : ℤ)
   135	  support : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   136	    coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ d.P
   137	  baseClass : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   138	    Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   139	  h0_one : Sheaf.h0
   140	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) = 1
   141	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   142	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) 1)
   143	  translated : IsSplitWitness C
   144	    (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K))
   145	
   146	/-- Positive twisting followed by point subtraction produces the exact field-level translated
   147	rank-one witness.
   148	
   149	The greedy theorem supplies `S`, `h0 = 1`, and preservation of `H1 = 0`.  The explicit
   150	`baseSubtraction` bridge then supplies the base divisor `Z`; class arithmetic shows that
   151	`W₀ - S` presents `mu` translated by the base-field class `chartTwistClass C d.m Z`.  The last
   152	line applies the existing `IsSplitWitness` consumer, so no unrelated Picard class can satisfy
   153	the conclusion. -/
   154	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult
   155	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   156	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) :
   157	    Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d) := by
   158	  obtain ⟨-, S, hS0, hSdeg, hSsupport, hS0one, hS1⟩ :=
   159	    exists_isSplitWitness_of_drop C μ d.m
   160	      (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   161	      d.genusValue d.excess d.hχ d.M₀ d.hM₀ d.W₀ d.hW₀ d.hdeg d.h1
   162	      d.P d.hdense d.hPcl d.hPdeg
   163	  obtain ⟨Z, hSZ⟩ := d.baseSubtraction S hS0 hSdeg hSsupport
   164	  have hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - S) =
   165	      d.M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   166	        (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) := by
   167	    have hW₀ := d.hW₀
   168	    unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hW₀ hSZ ⊢
   169	    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add, Scheme.picClass_neg,
   170	      hW₀, hSZ]
   171	    simp only [map_inv, inv_inv]
   172	    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
   173	    simp only [chartTwistClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, inv_one, mul_one,
   174	      pow_zero, one_mul]
   175	  have htranslated : IsSplitWitness C
   176	      (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K)) :=
   177	    isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass C μ d.m Z d.M₀ d.hM₀
   178	      (d.W₀ - S) hW hS1
   179	  exact ⟨{
   180	    S := S
   181	    Z := Z
   182	    nonnegative := hS0
   183	    degree := hSdeg
   184	    support := hSsupport
   185	    baseClass := hSZ
   186	    h0_one := hS0one
   187	    h1_vanishing := hS1
   188	    translated := htranslated
   189	  }⟩
   190	
   191	end DropPackage
   192	
   193	end
   194	
   195	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# The canonical rank-one evaluation divisor
    12	
    13	The noetherian-free canonical divisor theorem is initially stated on affine test algebras.  This
    14	module performs the family-level integration that the Abel inverse needs: it glues those affine
    15	choices over an arbitrary test scheme using separatedness and arbitrary-test uniqueness, transports
    16	the resulting section through the divisor representer, and extends it to the big site.
    17	
    18	No field-fibre dimension assertion is used here.  The only input is the lambda-tied
    19	`PicRankOneOpen` membership contract, so the resulting `PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData` is a
    20	genuine family-level datum.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    34	
    35	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    36	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    37	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    38	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    39	
    40	noncomputable section
    41	
    42	/-! ## The arbitrary-test canonical section -/
    43	
    44	private theorem canonicalRankOneSection_compat {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    45	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) T)
    46	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op T)) :
    47	    ∀ (U V : T.left.affineOpens) (h : U.1 ≤ V.1),
    48	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T h)
    49	          (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
    50	            (divRepAffP1Map_comp C)
    51	            (picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C)
    52	              (Over.fromSpecAffine T V).op hlam))
    53	        = canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
    54	            (divRepAffP1Map_comp C)
    55	            (picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C)
    56	              (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op hlam) := by
    57	  intro U V h
    58	  let fU : overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1) ⟶ T := Over.fromSpecAffine T U
    59	  let fV : overSpec k Γ(T.left, V.1) ⟶ T := Over.fromSpecAffine T V
    60	  let r : Γ(T.left, V.1) →ₐ[k] Γ(T.left, U.1) := Over.resAlgHom T h
    61	  let lamU : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)) :=
    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map fU.op lam
    63	  let lamV : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k Γ(T.left, V.1)) :=
    64	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map fV.op lam
    65	  have hlamU : lamU ∈ (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj
    66	      (op (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1))) :=
    67	    picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C) fU.op hlam
    68	  have hlamV : lamV ∈ (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj
    69	      (op (overSpec k Γ(T.left, V.1))) :=
    70	    picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C) fV.op hlam
    71	  have hclass : lamU.1 = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap r) lamV.1 := by
    72	    change picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam.1 =
    73	      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap (Over.resAlgHom T h))
    74	        (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T V) lam.1)
    75	    rw [← picEtMap_comp]
    76	    exact congrArg (fun q => picEtMap C q lam.1)
    77	      (Over.fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom h).symm
    78	  have habel : abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, U.1)
    79	      (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom r
    80	        (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
    81	          (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamV)) =
    82	      picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1) lamU.1 := by
    83	    calc
    84	      abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, U.1)
    85	          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom r
    86	            (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
    87	              (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamV))
    88	          = PicEtAff.mapAlg C r
    89	              (abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, V.1)
    90	                (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
    91	                  (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamV)) :=
    92	            (abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom r _).symm
    93	      _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C r
    94	          (picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, V.1) lamV.1) := by
    95	            rw [canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem_abel
    96	              (pi := divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamV]
    97	      _ = picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1)
    98	          (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap r) lamV.1) :=
    99	            (picEtAffineEquiv_naturality C r lamV.1).symm
   100	      _ = picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1) lamU.1 := by rw [hclass]
   101	  exact canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem_unique (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
   102	    (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamU
   103	    (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom r
   104	      (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
   105	        (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamV)) habel

   107	noncomputable def canonicalRankOneSection {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   108	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) T)
   109	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op T)) :
   110	    divFamZarAff C (genus C) T :=
   111	  ⟨fun U => canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
   112	      (divRepAffP1Map_comp C)
   113	      (picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C)
   114	        (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op hlam),
   115	    canonicalRankOneSection_compat lam hlam⟩
   116	
   117	private theorem picEtAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine
   118	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s : picEt C T) (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
   119	    picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1)
   120	        (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) s) = s.1 U := by
   121	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_apply, picEtMap_val,
   122	    picEtMapVal_eq_mapAlg C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) s
   123	      (top_le_preimage_fromSpecAffine T U)]
   124	  set psi := Over.appLEAlgHom (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) U.1
   125	    (overSpecTopAffine Γ(T.left, U.1)).1
   126	      (top_le_preimage_fromSpecAffine T U) with hpsi
   127	  set e := (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k Γ(T.left, U.1)).toAlgHom with he
   128	  have hcomp : e.comp psi = AlgHom.id k Γ(T.left, U.1) := by
   129	    rw [he, hpsi]
   130	    exact fromSpecAffine_ΓTop_comp_appLEAlgHom T U
   131	  calc
   132	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C e (PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi (s.1 U)) =
   133	        PicEtAff.mapAlg C (e.comp psi) (s.1 U) :=
   134	      (PicEtAff.mapAlg_comp C psi e (s.1 U)).symm
   135	    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C (AlgHom.id k Γ(T.left, U.1)) (s.1 U) := by rw [hcomp]
   136	    _ = s.1 U := PicEtAff.mapAlg_id C (s.1 U)
   137	
   138	theorem canonicalRankOneSection_abel {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   139	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) T)
   140	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op T)) :
   141	    abelDivAff' C (genus C) T (canonicalRankOneSection lam hlam) = lam.1 := by
   142	  refine picEt.ext fun U => ?_
   143	  rw [abelDivAff'_val, canonicalRankOneSection]
   144	  calc
   145	    abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, U.1)
   146	        (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
   147	          (divRepAffP1Map_comp C)
   148	          (picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C)
   149	            (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op hlam))
   150	        = picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1)
   151	            ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map
   152	              (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op lam).1 :=
   153	          canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem_abel
   154	            (pi := divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) _
   155	    _ = lam.1.1 U := picEtAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine T lam.1 U
   156	
   157	theorem canonicalRankOneSection_layer {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   158	    (lam : (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op T)) :
   159	    (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
   160	        (canonicalRankOneSection lam.1 lam.2) = lam.1 := by
   161	  apply Subtype.ext
   162	  exact canonicalRankOneSection_abel lam.1 lam.2
